hooks.command: { f=$(jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/.nuxt/*|*/.output/*) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.vue|*.ts|*.js|*.mjs|*.css|*.json|*.md) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no-install prettier --write --log-level warn "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
